name: tell_slam_dust
for: tell before a heavy slam: brute slam / late slam (and any held overhead slam: statue falling statue, butcher cleave if wanted), at Blow.tell / Attack tell
anchor_note: anchor_px = the brute middle on the ground (w_slam frame 4); the trickle falls from the raised maul head at (12,5), 1.6 m up and 0.8 m in front
faces: left (as brute w_slam; mirror with the sprite)
notes: Dust and grains trickle off the raised maul head down to the ground, and the grit round its feet shivers in two hops (the ground tensing under the weight), with a faint dust breath. 1 s; for a late slam held longer, hold the last 6 frames on a loop (frames 6-11 repeat cleanly enough) or replay. Small, earth-coloured, no glow: reads as weight about to fall.
